name: Jesus And Golden Retriever
source_generation_prompt: Premium pet memorial fine-art portrait, realistic anatomy and expressive natural eyes, exquisite detailed fur, painterly realism with subtle oil brushwork, tasteful luminous atmosphere, refined restrained color palette. Portrait 4:5 full-bleed standalone artwork, NOT a framed mockup. Entire face, ears and important limbs comfortably inside the canvas, generous safe margins. One dog only, no text, letters, logos or watermarks, no extra limbs. Depict a respectful traditional portrayal of Jesus with shoulder-length dark hair, beard, compassionate expression and modest flowing robes with one golden retriever. Jesus kneeling in a sunlit heavenly meadow, hand resting gently on the dog's shoulder, ivory robes and soft golden horizon. The dog has natural canine anatomy, no wings. Dog's face prominent and recognizable, both subjects clearly visible.
